scope.operator_request: Make sure to continue the work all the way for all languages to get the entire UI completely translated

semantic_notes: کم / متوسط / زیادہ form a natural, distinct ascending effort scale; neutral product register, no address/formality issue.
بیداری uses glossary noun; فعال ہے / فعال ہیں correctly distinguishes singular and plural armed states, not delivery completion.

ایک بار is an idiomatic one-time cadence, also valid in embedded schedule prose. Committed keepRepeatLabel uses a separate keep_as_once key on null cadence; repeating schedule embeds only the non-null branch.

No manual bidi controls, arrows, Latin literals or punctuation in the three effort labels or cadence. Count display remains the Latin-digit raw interpolation. Logical string order checked; visual bidi ordering/shaping not exercised.

No numeric maxCells/maxChars hints for these five keys; effort labels are single words, cadence is a natural two-word equivalent, and wake count remains a brief status clause. No measured layout claim.
limits: Committed catalogue and call-site static review only; no native UI, browser, screenshots, pseudolocale or pixel/geometry proof.
Focused repo messageArguments validator helper and existing ICU parser/formatter executed; no full scanner, generator, build, tsc, dependency installation or worktree.

Receipt created in session scratch under explicit no-repo-edits instruction; manager must retain the same bytes in repository evidence and use one receipt for both ledger rows. No ledger written by auditor.

context.role: count clause naming how many scheduled wakes are armed, on the composer's wakes chip and as the trailing tally of the run panel's Wakes section
context.tone: short status clause, lowercase after the number, no trailing punctuation
context.note: A wake is a scheduled follow-up the agent set for itself; armed means it is set and will fire. One string serves both surfaces so they cannot drift. Provide every CLDR plural category the language needs.

placeholders.count: Numeric selector for CLDR plural categories. English uses exact =1 to preserve the original strict count === 1 branch; translators add their CLDR arms.
placeholders.count_display: Raw String(count), preserving the former JavaScript interpolation without rounding or grouping. Print this, not count.

context.role: cadence of a wake that fires a single time, in a wake row and inside the schedule sentences that quote a wake's repeat
context.note: Opposite of 'every {duration}'. It is embedded mid-sentence by other strings (for example 'keep as once'), so it must read as a lowercase adverb.
